description: This file defines the ThingsUpdater class, an Akka actor that manages subscriptions and message forwarding related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles incoming events, tags, out-of-sync notifications, and manages shard region communications for the thing search updater service.

classes.name: ThingsUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for managing subscription to thing events, handling out-of-sync notifications, and routing various message types to shard regions for the Eclipse Ditto 'things' search updater service.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration object for the ThingsUpdater actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, specifying how different message types are processed.

methods.name: retrieveShardIds
methods.description: Requests shard region statistics to determine current shard IDs for subscription management.

methods.name: updateSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates message subscriptions based on the current shard IDs, subscribing to new shards and unsubscribing from removed ones.

methods.name: handleRetrieveStatisticsDetails
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve namespace statistics details.

methods.name: processThingTag
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingTag messages and forwards to shard region.

methods.name: updateThings
methods.description: Processes out-of-sync notifications for multiple things and issues update commands.

methods.name: updateThing
methods.description: Processes an out-of-sync notification for a single thing and forwards an update command.

methods.name: processPolicyReferenceTag
methods.description: Processes PolicyReferenceTag messages and forwards them appropriately.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingEvent messages and forwards them to the shard region.

methods.name: forwardJsonifiableToShardRegion
methods.description: Forwards messages implementing Jsonifiable to the shard region after extracting IDs and metadata.

methods.name: forwardEventToShardRegion
methods.description: Forwards Event instances to the shard region, converting them to JSON.

methods.name: forwardToShardRegion
methods.description: Generic method to forward any message type to the shard region with proper message envelope wrapping and namespace blocking.
